name: Vision
description: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. description: When this model’s melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

description: The only cohort that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Aberration.

name: Vitalizer (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly monstrosity. If the target monstrosity is in range, it gains 1 focus point.

description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Healing, Power Field, and Spellcaster. name: Combat Drugs (★ Action)
description: RNG 5. Target Cohort in this model’s battlegroup gains Aggressive for one turn. (A model with Aggressive can run or charge without spending a focus point or being forced.)

name: Inflict Pain
description: When it hits a warbeast with this weapon, this model can place 1 fury point on or remove 1 fury point from the warbeast.

name: Brain Damage
description: A model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.

name: Companion [Exulon Nostilla]
description: This model is included in any army that includes Exulon Nostilla. If Nostilla is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Nostilla’s battlegroup.

name: Hyper-Aggressive
description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

name: Hormone Manipulation
description: When this model begins its activation in Nostilla's control range, choose one of the following effects. Hormone Manipulation effects last for one round.

name: •Adrenal Surge
description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, models with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

name: •Endorphin Dump
description: This model gains +2 to its attack rolls.

name: •Dopamine Boost
description: This model gains Overtake, and Swift Hunter. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".) (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Impervious Flesh
description: When this model suffers a damage roll, roll one fewer die.

name: Critical Decapitation
description: On a critical hit, double the damage exceeding the ARM of the model hit. A model disabled by this attack cannot make a Tough roll.

name: Beat Back
description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

name: Shadow Bind
description: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: Reload [1]
description: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Grievous Wounds
description: On a direct hit, a model hit by this weapon loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.

name: Man Catcher
description: A warrior model hit by this attack suffers –2 DEF and cannot advance while within this model’s melee range for one round.

Counterblast
description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 5" of the spellcaster, the spellcaster can make one basic melee or ranged attack targeting that model, then Counterblast expires. Counterblast lasts for one round.

name: Bulldoze
description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

name: Pain Maddened
description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, it gains +2 SPD for one round.

name: Full Battery Fire (★ Attack)
description: This weapon becomes POW 20/10 for this attack. On a direct hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a damage roll with POW equal to the blast damage POW of this weapon. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the blast damage POW of this weapon.

description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model’s melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

name: Soul Taker: Requiem

description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

name: •Spirit-Driven
description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, it can spend one soul token to gain +2 SPD that activation.

description: This model generates soul tokens as if it were a living model.

Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

description: RNG 5. Target friendly Immortal trooper model. If the model is in range, the models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

name: •Fight to the Last
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough for one round.

name: •Wings of Death
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Construct warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Incorporeal for one round. If the model is in range and is a trooper model, the models in its unit also gain Incorporeal for one round.

name: Inhuman Resolve
description: When a friendly warrior model within 10" of this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can remove 1 damage point. featDescription: While in Mordikaar’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and Poltergeist. Void Wind lasts for one round.

description: When an enemy model casts a spell while in the spellcaster’s control range, double the COST of the spell. Additionally, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells on models/units in the spellcaster’s control range.

name: Leadership [Void Spirits]
description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Void Spirit models gain Tough and Stealth.

name: Poltergeist
description: When an enemy model misses this model with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from this model.

name: Void Walk
description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed a living or undead enemy model with an attack during its Combat Action, you can place this model anywhere completely within 8" of its current location.

name: Blood Boon
description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed an enemy model with this weapon, this model can cast a spell without spending focus or fury points.

name: Life Drinker
description: When this model boxes a living enemy model with this weapon, this model can remove d3 damage points.

Ornery
description: The spellcaster gains Retaliatory Strike. Ornery lasts for one round. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

description: This model cannot become knocked down, cannot be placed, and cannot be moved by a push, slam, or throw.

name: Torment

description: This model can use Full Boar at the start of its activation. This model gains +2 SPD that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Full Boar can be used only once per activation.

description: When this model advances during its Normal Movement, for one round other friendly models gain concealment while within 3" of this model.

description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

description: This model can be forced once during its activation to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

description: On a critical hit with this weapon during this model’s Combat Action, after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional attack with this weapon against the model hit.

description: This command attachment can be added to an Immortal unit.

description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to give models in its unit +2 DEF for one round.

description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

description: During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. name: Ghost Shot
description: This model ignores LOS, concealment, and cover when making attacks with this weapon.

description: Play this card any time during your activation on one of your models. That model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical this activation.

description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Unstoppable this activation.

name: Careful Reconnaissance
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models/units. Those models gain Pathfinder this activation.

name: Defenses
description: Play this card at the start of the game after turn order has been determined and standard terrain and objectives have been placed for the scenario, but before deploying models. If you are the first player, you can place up to two Defenses. If you are the second player, you can place up to three Defenses. If both players play the Defenses Command Card, take turns placing Defenses starting with the second player. A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be placed at the start of the game within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or another Defense terrain feature.

name: Defenses
description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Illumination
description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

description: Play this card at any time during your turn. Immediately remove a Defense from the table.
